brief:
Israeli occupation authorities demolished multiple homes belonging to the Abu Qurshan family in Rahat, in the Naqab, Shehab Wire reported Monday. The demolitions mark the latest in a series of house destructions targeting Arab residents across the region.

The operation comes as Israeli authorities intensify demolition campaigns against Arab-inhabited properties in the area. Residents and rights advocates have characterized the demolitions as part of a systematic policy restricting Arab communities' access to planning permits and legal construction options, effectively narrowing available housing solutions for the population.
